The '''''Agrelcu Haalta''''', which could be translated as the '''''Aggressive Defender''''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], was a [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Troonol]]. It was the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of a [[Qunaalac]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that patrolled the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Troonol]]'s [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] protected the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. His fleet consisted of ten [[Qunaalac]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] which he led from his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''Agrelcu Haalta''. The rest of his fleet was a collection of [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunships]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Troonol's fleet heavily patrolled the ''[[Pabol Hutta]]'' [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] through the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'', where [[outlander]]s were not allowed to travel. His fleet regularly patrolled the route between the guardian [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Gos Hutta system/Legends|Gos Hutta]] and [[Mulatan]] and, more periodically, the routes to [[Elgit]] and [[Varl/Legends|Varl]].<ref name="LoNH" />
